note: Plan posts #6-10, moved to 18-22 Oct (posting resumed 18 Oct). Data month Aug 2026.

posts.text:
77.4% of the UPI QR codes reported by banks sit with one bank: Yes Bank, 62.93 crore codes, in Aug 2026. Axis holds 16.0%.

QR codes grew 16.5% over the year.

#UPI #DigitalPayments #YesBank
indiacreditlens.com

image.title: Yes Bank holds 77.4% of UPI QR codes
image.source: Source: RBI, bank-wise ATM, POS and card statistics

posts.text:
Bank credit to NBFCs grew 37.5% in Aug 2026, to ₹21.64L Cr.

NBFCs are 34.4% of bank credit to services, but took 47.8% of the new services credit.

#NBFC #BankCredit #IndianBanking
indiacreditlens.com

image.title: NBFCs: 34.4% of services credit, 47.8% of the new
image.source: Source: RBI, Sectoral Deployment of Bank Credit

posts.text:
Credit card balances at banks grew 3.6% in Aug 2026. Card spend at shops grew 9.1%.

Our test finds that a change in card spend shows up in balances a month later: one of the few links in our model that has passed a test.

#CreditCards #DigitalPayments
indiacreditlens.com

image.title: Card balances +3.6%, card spend at shops +9.1%
image.source: Source: RBI, Sectoral Deployment of Bank Credit; RBI, ATM, POS and card statistics

posts.text:
Public sector banks hold 22.0% of credit card spend at shops, but took 51.0% of its growth: +23.9% in Aug 2026 against the market's 9.1%. SBI alone grew 22.3%.

#CreditCards #PublicSectorBanks #DigitalPayments

posts.text:
Loans against fixed deposits grew 43.2% in Aug 2026, to ₹2.04L Cr: growth up 28.58 pp on the month.

Our model has no explanation for it yet. Deposit rates? Liquidity needs? Tell us.

#BankCredit #FixedDeposits
